mso-bidi-theme-font:minor-bidi;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:
EN-US;mso-bidi-language:AR-SA">REASON: For the avoidance of doubt and in the
interests of proper planning.</span></p>

<p class="Default"><u>Fire Statement <o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Notwithstanding the approved plans, the development hereby
approved shall be implemented in accordance with the fire safety details
submitted and approved under PL/0778/24 dated 12/11/2024, and retained as such unless
otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>



</p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">REASON: In order to achieve the highest standards of fire
safety and ensure the safety of all building users<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="Default"><u>Green Roof/
Photo-Voltaic Panels <o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Notwithstanding the approved plans, the development hereby
approved shall be implemented in accordance with the green roof/ photo-voltaic panel
details submitted and approved under PL/0802/24 dated 30/09/2024, and retained
as such unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>



</p><p class="Default">REASON: To ensure the
delivery of a sustainable development<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="Default"><u>Play Space <o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Notwithstanding the approved plans, the development hereby
approved shall be implemented in accordance with the play space details
submitted and approved under PL/0802/24 dated 30/09/2024, and retained as such unless
otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>



</p><p class="Default">REASON: To ensure that
the development makes appropriate provision for play and informal recreation.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="Default" style="margin-left:0cm;text-indent:0cm;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><u>Delivery
and Servicing Plan<o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="Default">Notwithstanding the details hereby approved, the development
shall not be first occupied until a Delivery and Servicing Plan has first been
submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The revised
Delivery and Servicing Plan shall include full details of the onsite Refuse
Management Strategy. The development shall be carried out in accordance with
the details so agreed and shall be retained as such thereafter. All deliveries
and servicing associated with the development shall be carried out only in
accordance with the approved details.<o:p></o:p></p><p>



</p><p class="Default">REASON: To ensure that the transport network impact of
deliveries associated with the development are managed<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="Default"><u>Parking and Management Plan<o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="Default" style="margin-left:0cm;text-indent:0cm;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1">The
development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until a detailed parking
management plan has been submitted to and agreed in writing by the local
planning authority. The plan shall make provision for:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default" style="margin-left:0cm;text-indent:0cm;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1">a)
details of how the parking spaces would be managed;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default" style="margin-left:0cm;text-indent:0cm;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1">b)
identify the electric vehicle charging point spaces that are to be provided as
'active' spaces and those as 'passive' spaces;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default" style="margin-left:0cm;text-indent:0cm;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1">c)
detail the relevant blue-badge parking spaces within the car park;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default" style="margin-left:0cm;text-indent:0cm;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1">d)
detail the provision of cycle parking for residential and non-residential
users, including visitors to the development, which shall include the type of
cycle stands proposed (including specification);<o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default" style="margin-left:0cm;text-indent:0cm;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p>













</p><p class="Default" style="margin-left:0cm;text-indent:0cm;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1">REASON:
To ensure that the development provides sufficient blue badge parking, cycle,
motorcycle and electric vehicle charging points.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="Default"><u>Air Source Heat Pump and Revised Energy Strategy<o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">a) Notwithstanding the approved plans, the development
hereby approved shall be implemented in accordance with the details relating to
the Air Source Heat Pump and Revised Energy Strategy submitted and approved under
<a name="_Hlk196689302">PL/0665/23 </a>dated 31/01/2024, and retained as such unless
otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">b) Within 3 months (or other such period agreed in writing
by the local planning authority) of the final completion of the development a
post construction assessment shall be undertaken demonstrating compliance with
the approved Energy Statement; which thereafter shall be submitted to the local
planning authority for written approval.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">&nbsp;</span></p><p>







</p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">REASON: To ensure the delivery of a sustainable development<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="Default"><u>Tree protection<o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="Default">Prior to occupation or use of the site, the LPA will be
provided with clear and obvious proof that the details of the Aboricultural
Impact Assessment (Prepared by PJC, dated 9 June 2020) have been adhered to,
either through separate reports or single larger report, summarising details of
each clerk of works visit and including (where relevant) photographic evidence
of adherence to the aforementioned report and Tree Protection Plan. This
condition may only be discharged on completion of the development, subject to
satisfactory evidence of compliance through contemporaneous monitoring of tree
protection throughout construction, by the appointed specialist<o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p>





</p><p class="Default">REASON: to safeguard the retained trees adjacent to the
application site during construction&nbsp;<b><i><o:p></o:p></i></b></p>

<p class="Default" style="margin-left:0cm;text-indent:0cm;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><u>Audio-Visual
Access</u><o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default" style="margin-left:0cm;text-indent:0cm;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1">The
relevant building, plot or phase (whichever is relevant), including associated
car park access and ancillary facilities hereby approved shall not be occupied
until: <o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default" style="margin-left:0cm;text-indent:0cm;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1">(i)
an audio-visual access control system has been installed; or (ii) such
alternative security measures have been installed that shall first have been
submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning <o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default" style="margin-left:0cm;text-indent:0cm;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1">authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p>







</p><p class="Default" style="margin-left:0cm;text-indent:0cm;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1">REASON:
To ensure that the development achieves a high standard of residential quality
for future occupiers of the development.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="Default"><u>Overheating<o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="Default">The development hereby approved in relation to each building,
plot or phase (whichever is relevant) shall not be occupied until guidance
information to occupants on minimizing the dwelling overheating risk in line
with the cooling hierarchy (as set out in policy SI4 of The London Plan 2021)
is submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. <o:p></o:p></p><p>



</p><p class="Default">REASON: To ensure the delivery of an energy efficient and
sustainable development<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="Default"><u>Air Quality Assessment<o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="Default">a) Notwithstanding the Air Quality Assessment hereby approved,
a scheme of mitigation, appropriate in scale, to address the exceedance of the
transport emissions benchmark (TEB) identified, or address the exceedance of
the TEB in scheme design (i.e. reduce vehicle trips associated with the
development) shall be submitted to and approved by, the local planning
authority prior to occupation of each building, plot or phase (whichever is
relevant). The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved
scheme of mitigation so agreed and shall be retained as such thereafter.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default">b) An assessment of the impacts of the communal boiler to
ensure that there are no adverse impacts on air quality at existing locations,
and that future occupants are not adversely impacted by its emissions. The
development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved scheme of
mitigation so agreed and shall be retained as such thereafter.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p>







</p><p class="Default">REASON: To safeguard the amenity of future occupiers of the
development and demonstrate compliant with Policy SI 1 (part B) of the London
Plan 2021.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="Default"><u>Landscape Management and Maintenance<o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="Default">The development relating to the Detailed Application hereby
approved prior to the first occupation of the relevant building, plot or phase
(whichever is relevant) until a scheme for the on-going management, management
programme of works and maintenance of all the hard and soft landscaping within
the development, to include a Landscape Management Plan, including long term
design objectives, management responsibilities and set out, graphically and /
or in writing, the overall functional and aesthetic objectives of the landscape
scheme and the steps (eg legal arrangements including ownership and management
responsibilities, planned maintenance tasks, any phased works, management
programme of works, monitoring procedures etc.) that will be taken after
implementation to ensure that the scheme be-comes successfully established and
reaches maturity. <o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="Default">The maintenance schedules should include details of the
arrangement for the implementation for all landscape areas including communal
residential areas green roof, blue infrastructure, other than small, privately
owned, domestic gardens and who is responsible for the maintenance. The
aforementioned details shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the
local planning authority. Details shall also include schedule of landscape
maintenance for year 1, years 2-5 and on-going maintenance from year 6 onwards.
The Landscape Management Plan and Landscape Maintenance Plan shall be carried
out in a timely manner as approved and shall be retained as such thereafter.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p>









</p><p class="Default">REASON: To ensure that the development makes provision for
hard and soft landscaping which contributes (i) to the creation of a high
quality, accessible, safe and attractive public realm and (ii) to the
enhancement, creation and management of biodiversity<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="Default"><u>Noise and Machinery<o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="Default">a) Notwithstanding the approved plans, the development hereby
approved shall be implemented in accordance with the details relating to plant
machinery and noise mitigation submitted and approved under PL/0781/24 dated 07/10/2024, and retained as
such unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default">b) The development hereby approved shall not be occupied until
the details noted below have been submitted to and approved in writing by the
local planning authority:</p><p class="Default" style="margin-left:51.95pt;text-indent:-14.15pt">i) amended
details, if any, (including specification) of any extraction flues, plant/
ventilation systems, rainwater disposal systems (including downpipes) and any
rollershutters, gates and other means of controlling access to the car park or
areas within the site including, but not limited to the Mews Street adjacent to
Plot 03; and<o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default" style="margin-left:51.95pt;text-indent:-14.15pt">ii) details
to demonstrate that the proposed substation, other newly proposed
plant/machinery and any other amended details to previously approved
plant/machinery/ ventilation systems would meet the plant noise criteria set
out in the submitted Noise Assessment (prepared by Ardent, dated June 2020) and
would not adversely affect future occupiers of the site in terms of noise
disturbance.</p><p class="Default">c) A follow up acoustic survey to demonstrate installed plant
compliance shall be submitted within six months of the first occupation of the
development. <o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p>The application shall be implemented in full accordance with
such details and be maintained as such thereafter.</p><p class="Default"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p>REASON: To ensure that potential adverse noise impacts to
residential premises within the development are mitigated.</p>

<p class="Default" style="margin-left:0cm;text-indent:0cm;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><u>Secure
by Design <o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="Default" style="margin-left:0cm;text-indent:0cm;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1">Evidence
of certification of Secure by Design Accreditation for the development shall be
submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing for approval before any
part of the development is occupied or used. The development shall only be
completed and operated in accordance with any approval.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default" style="margin-left:0cm;text-indent:0cm;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p>





</p><p class="Default" style="margin-left:0cm;text-indent:0cm;mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1">REASON:
In the interests of creating safer and more sustainable communities and to
safeguard amenity by reducing the risk of crime and the fear of crime.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="Default"><u>Contamination </u><b><i><u><span style="color:#538135;
mso-themecolor:accent6;mso-themeshade:191"><o:p></o:p></span></u></i></b></p><p class="Default">a) The development
hereby approved in relation to each building, plot or phase (whichever is
relevant) shall not be first occupied until a verification report demonstrating
completion of the works set out in the approved Geo-Environmental &amp;
Geotechnical Assessment (Ground) Investigation) Report (Prepared by
JOMAS Engineering Environmental), and the effectiveness of the remediation
shall be submitted to and approved, in writing, by the local planning
authority. The report shall include results of sampling and monitoring carried
out in accordance with the approved verification plan to demonstrate that the
site remediation criteria have been met. It shall also include any plan (a
'long-term monitoring and maintenance plan') for longer-term monitoring of
pollutant linkages, maintenance and arrangements for contingency action, as
identified in the verification plan, and for the reporting of this to the local
planning authority. The long-term monitoring and maintenance plan shall be
implemented as approved. A verification report is only required to be submitted
and approved once per phase.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="Default">b) If, during development, contamination not previously
identified is found to be present at the site then no further construction of
that building, plot or phase (whichever is relevant) of the development (unless
otherwise agreed in writing with the local planning authority) shall be carried
out until the developer has submitted a remediation strategy to the local
planning authority detailing how this unanticipated contamination is to be
dealt with and obtained written approval from the local planning authority. The
remediation strategy shall be implemented as approved.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="Default"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p>









</p><p class="Default">REASON: To protect groundwater and future end users of the
site and to ensure that the development does not activate or spread potential
contamination at the site and that the land is appropriately remediated for the
approved uses.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="Default"><u>Water Strategy<o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm"><span lang="EN-US">The development hereby approved in relation to each
building, plot or phase (whichever is relevant) shall not be occupied until a
Water Strategy, demonstrating that the mains water consumption of the proposed
development will not exceed 105 litres per person per day, has first been</span><span lang="EN-US"> submitted
to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority. The development
shall be carried out in accordance with the strategy so agreed and shall be
